description: Get one account's live details (balances, credit limit, type, institution, last 4 digits) by its account id from list_accounts. The response includes a `warnings` array of notices about banks that could not contribute (for example, a bank that needs reconnecting), each with a message and, when relevant, a reconnect_url.

account_id.description: The account id, as returned by list_accounts (for example demo_acc_chase_checking).

name: get_account
title: Get Account Details
